reason: Exposes a list specification for toRatPoly so literal number-field coordinates reduce in the kernel. The new csimp theorem toRatPoly_eq redirects every compiled use to toRatPolyImpl, whose body is exactly the previous toRatPoly body: DensePoly.ofCoeffs (f.toArray.map fun coeff : Int => (coeff : Rat)). Generated C uses the Array.mapMUnsafe map and existing trailing-zero trimming; the list specification is noncomputable and is not executed. The other edits prove the specification/implementation equality and adapt coeff_toRatPoly. The measured integer-factorization operations therefore retain the same array conversion and normalization algorithm.
